notes.title: TIES: Soul Link is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Today is a very important day because the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/northtokyogames/ties-soul-link]Kickstarter[/url][/b] campaign of [b]TIES: Soul Link[/b] is now [b]live[/b]! After a lot of work, it’s finally here. The campaign has lots of amazing exclusive [b]rewards[/b] and [b]Early Birds[/b], so make sure you check it out!

Recently, I also released a new [b]trailer[/b] to celebrate the launch of the campaign, where you can see some of the game’s features and characters, including exclusive things never seen before. Give it a watch and accompany [b]Kiro and Chloe[/b] in an uncertain future where the two will get separated, and Kiro will have to look for Chloe and save both of them while exploring very diverse cities with a cyberpunk touch and battling ruthless enemies.

[previewyoutube=TeTYFWAo084;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, thank you so much for all your support, I never would've come this far without it. Go show your support now if you want to help Kiro in his adventure and get some of the amazing rewards!

notes.title: The Kickstarter campaign of TIES: Soul Link launches on October 8th!
notes.notes:
The countdown for the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/northtokyogames/ties-soul-link]Kickstarter[/url][/b] campaign of [b]TIES: Soul Link[/b] is almost over! The campaign is launching on [b]October 8th[/b], and it will bring some adorable and interesting [b]rewards[/b]. Those interested can sign up for it now so they don’t miss out on those and the [b]Early Birds[/b].

The [b]physical rewards[/b] will include a hardcover 200 pages [b]Artbook[/b] with embossed barnish details, a super cute and fluffy [b]27cm tall Kiro Plush[/b] and a [b]very limited 20 cm tall Kiro Statue[/b] that will also give you access to a secret room in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/b043c1e72170d83c122c22f8f5c303e61011c47a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/1a2be1f2c494a1addf08cdad0d998175f8d2f7be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/cbd22af20cec490f905b6063b724ed2f2357d4da.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, the [b]digital rewards[/b] are a special [b]digital edition[/b] of TIES: Soul Link that will include the [b]original soundtrack[/b], and [b]exclusive skins[/b] like the Dark Kiro and the Red Fox Kitsune. There will also be very [b]exclusive rewards[/b] that will allow people who support the campaign [b]to design in-game content[/b], like an NPC or an enemy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/6708af841268129b86408b52eea4fab471325a82.png[/img]

While you wait for the campaign to start, remember that you can give a shot to the [b]Demo[/b] if you haven’t yet; and it will be available all through the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

We hope you will like everything that’s coming soon to [b]TIES: Soul Link[/b] soon! As always, thank you for your support. ♥

notes.title: THE NEW TIES: SOUL LINK DEMO AND TRAILER IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Check out the new trailer for Ties: Soul Link, which kicks off the launch of the new demo and Kickstarter preview page:

[previewyoutube=E5nLvIp7Zv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]These are the highlights of the NEW DEMO:[/b]

[list]
[*] Includes [b]various cinematics[/b] that will put you in context of the game's exciting story.
[*] The [b]introduction to the story of Ties: Soul Link[/b], discover the origin of Kiro's adventure through the world of 2097.
[*] You will be able to test the [b]fire and shield runes[/b] from the beginning. 
[*] Discover the [b]2 hidden bosses[/b] in the first zone.
[*] [b]The cost has been lowered to the hotel and the bank[/b], that before had a very high cost and could not be tested if you didn't spend some time trying to use/unlock them.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056822/6708af841268129b86408b52eea4fab471325a82.png[/img]

You can now enter the preview page of the Kickstarter campaign that is being prepared. Soon we will be telling you more about it and we are sure you want to be the first person to know about it, sign up now and don't miss anything ^^
